title: Potential kidney-related medication risk
why: Ibuprofen is an NSAID that may worsen kidney function in people with chronic kidney disease.
review: A qualified clinician or pharmacist should review kidney function, medical history and medication before use. This prototype rule requires clinical validation.
source: National Kidney Foundation, Pain Medicines and Kidney Disease: https://www.kidney.org/kidney-topics/pain-medicines-and-kidney-disease
